label: Some model satisfies jointly: the anchors, the #1113 bridge, N1, N2, N3 and…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: A model with the whole, two parts a and b that cause each other, a causing the whole, and a non-existent number two: the whole has an existing cause, every naturalist variant and the floor item hold, nothing causes itself, the whole-to-part bridge fails, since it would make a cause itself, and a, b witness the certified loop (distinct proper parts causing each other, a causing the whole).
